# AvailVidMem64

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AvailVidMem64:UInt64
```

**Returns:** The free video memory in bytes, or 0 when no graphics window is open.

## Description

The amount of video memory that is free for this program, in bytes, as a `UInt64`, so a graphics card with more than 2 GB is not cut off. [AvailVidMem](AvailVidMem) gives the same number as an `Int`. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* The number is the memory budget the graphics driver reports for this program, so it also counts what other programs use.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Print "Free video memory: " + (AvailVidMem64() / 1048576) + " MB"
WaitKey
```
